extraction.Name: Jeffrey Miller
extraction.Recorded patent: Recorded June 25, 1918; records do not indicate by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Aetna Life Insurance Company for $2,000.00 on August 1, 1918; Aetna Life Insurance Company mortgage satisfied September 1923; then mortgaged to W. S. Slaughter for $2,500.00; on June 28, 1928 Miller and his wife conveyed the land by deed to Iris Baldwin for $1.00 and other valuable consideration subject to $2,500.00 mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612824 issued; southeast quarter of section 2, township 95, north of range 71; Miller's wife joined in mortgage and conveyance transactions; Aetna Life Insurance Company mortgage dated August 1, 1918 for $2,000.00, satisfied September 1923; second mortgage to W. S. Slaughter for $2,500.00; conveyance to Iris Baldwin dated June 28, 1928
